question: How many players can remain outside the circle in the first six overs of a T20 cricket match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **2 players can remain outside the circle in the first six overs of a T20 cricket match.**
 
• **T20 is a shortened game format of cricket.**
 
• A newly-introduced variant of cricket from** the general one-day matches.**
 
• **T20 match format is a form of limited overs cricket** in that it involves two teams, **each with a single innings.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The key features is that each team bats for **a maximum of 20 overs.**
 
• The team batting first will set the** highest possible total.**
 
• While the side taking the **second innings will need to overtake that target.**
